ICRG was obtained by subscription in August 2018, capital controls in April 2017, and BIS REER in July 2018; current local editions/fields/coverage are unverified in assessment.json requirements REQ_ICRG_FX_RISK, REQ_CAPITAL_CONTROLS and REQ_BIS_REER_RETURNS.
changes: Split the accepted T5A, T5B, T6 and T7 stages into their distinct fitted models so each scope has its own disposition and original-result comparison.

Set fit-specific clocks from the accepted handoffs: T3/T4/T5A/T5B fiscal 1997–2017 (requested 2022); T6 fiscal 1997–2015 (requested 2020); T7 fiscal 1993–2017 (requested 2022). Table 6’s observed endpoint differs from the task-level fx_risk record (2017); Table 7 begins before the main FXRisk outcome window. Both differences are preserved.
No working analysis code or author_plan was staged. Preflight found no complete current-vintage pooled preparation path for the required sources, so no scientific run or extended result was produced.
limitations: All ten fit rows are blocked before estimation. The accepted author route is analysis-only and starts from prepared predecessor DTA files; it cannot establish a current-vintage pooled extension. The full-pipeline feasibility record is incomplete, and the accepted package inventory does not contain the missing current raw inputs/build outputs.

The paper reports the compiled Exhibit 21 dataset through fiscal 2014. Extending outcome t to 2022 requires source history for t−4 through 2018; no current EX-21 file or existing local constructor is verified. ICRG current edition/coverage is also unverified. This blocks T3, T4 and the Table 6 DM chain; Table 5B separately lacks a completed breadth/depth export route.

Table 5A’s author hand-collected fx.hedge input and current coverage are unverified, and the author source leaves the winsorized export unfinished. Its second predecessor fit has 804 missing contract/assets interaction values (N=5,467 versus 6,271 for the hedge-indicator fit); no values were imputed.

Table 6’s accepted DTA has fiscal years only through 2015 although the task-level sample record states 2017. Its actual five-year requested endpoint is therefore recorded as 2020. The full model’s saved original interaction terms are retained in comparison; the baseline model has no score × FTR interaction by construction.

Table 7’s accepted DTA fiscal-year field spans 1993–2017, not only the main fx_risk outcome window 1997–2017. Its accepted source requires current 2010-base BIS broad/narrow REER inputs, exp.fxi construction and a separate exp.hedge handoff; these and the finished SAS export are unverified. CRSP sources alone do not complete the branch.

The paper defines 2017 as the last year before TCJA adoption. Requested endpoints beyond 2017 cross that policy boundary; the supplied regressions retain fiscal-year effects but add no post-TCJA regime term. This interpretation limit is preserved, not adjusted by this job.

The current Compustat, segment, CCM and CRSP ranges are unfiltered source-date envelopes. They do not establish the required firm-level, country-level, match-window, outcome, or estimation-sample coverage. No row-level data are included in this report.
